name: Churin
desc: A Domovoy who studied Prime Ice sculpting diligently under Bragin, a Volkodlak master sculptor. However, Bragin's technique placed speed above all else, prioritizing the completion of works in the shortest possible time, and his training mostly focused on physical conditioning and technique. Naturally, Churin's days of hard work as an apprentice did little to cultivate any artistic sensibility, but he soon discovered that he had become the best fighter among all the apprentices...
